PP_UninCardText: Removes PhantomPad, its settings, ViGEmBus and HidHide, as if they had never been installed. Useful to try the installer from scratch.
PP_UninIntro: This leaves the PC as if PhantomPad had never been installed. These steps are done in order:
PP_UninSettingsText: Profiles, calibrations, games, commands and all PhantomPad options. If you turn this off they are kept for a future installation.
PP_UninNote: Windows will ask for permission for each driver. PhantomPad closes at the end. Then restart the PC before trying the installer.
PP_UninStepStop: Stop PhantomPad and show the hidden controllers again
PP_UninAppNotInstalled: this copy was not installed with Setup.exe: only the settings are deleted
PP_UninFinished: PhantomPad, ViGEmBus and HidHide were uninstalled. Restart the PC before trying the installer again.
